newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $21.99 mln in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $21.99 mln in T-bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius said on Thursday it sold all 450 million rupees ($21.99 million) worth of T-bills at this week's auction.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 104.1 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 9.65 percent at the Thursday auction, against 104.6 million rupees at 9.82 percent last week.

The bank sold 182-day bills worth 177.7 million rupees with an average yield of 9.98 percent, against 229.6 million rupees at 10.07 percent last week. It sold 364-day bills worth 168.2 million rupees at an average yield of 10.04 percent, against 115.8 million rupees at 10.06 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.93 percent per annum from 10.01 percent last week, the bank said.
